title: Network Basics
description: Sample exam covering basic networking concepts.

questions.text: Which protocol is primarily used to securely browse websites?
questions.explanation: HTTPS protects web traffic using TLS.

questions.text: Which of the following are private IPv4 address ranges?
questions.explanation: RFC 1918 defines the private IPv4 address ranges.

questions.text: Which device normally forwards packets between different IP networks?
questions.explanation: Routers forward traffic between IP networks.
